subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Screening and Risk Prediction
subtopics.description: Research on mammographic screening modalities (digital mammography, tomosynthesis, abbreviated MRI), risk prediction models including polygenic risk scores, and screening program effectiveness across diverse populations. Includes studies on mammographic density as a risk factor and screening disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Mammographic screening, tomosynthesis, MRI, polygenic risk scores, and mammographic density as a risk factor.

subtopics.label: Hormone Receptor-Positive Breast Cancer Treatment and Endocrine Therapy
subtopics.description: Studies on treatment of hormone receptor-positive breast cancer including CDK4/6 inhibitors (palbociclib), aromatase inhibitors, tamoxifen, endocrine therapy adherence and side effects, and outcomes in luminal subtypes. Includes pharmacogenomics of endocrine therapy and management of metastatic HR+ disease.
subtopics.short_description: CDK4/6 inhibitors, aromatase inhibitors, tamoxifen, and pharmacogenomics of endocrine therapy in luminal subtypes.

subtopics.label: Triple-Negative and HER2-Positive Breast Cancer Biology and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular biology, targeted therapies, and clinical outcomes of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) and HER2-positive breast cancer, including immunotherapy combinations, neoadjuvant chemotherapy response prediction, and novel therapeutic targets.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular biology, immunotherapy combinations, and neoadjuvant response prediction in TNBC and HER2-positive disease.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy: Circulating Tumor Cells and Circulating Tumor DNA
subtopics.description: Studies on the detection, characterization, and clinical utility of circulating tumor cells (CTCs) and circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) in breast cancer, including their use for treatment monitoring, resistance profiling, and prognostication in metastatic disease.
subtopics.short_description: Detection and clinical utility of circulating tumor cells and ctDNA for treatment monitoring and resistance profiling.

subtopics.label: Breast Reconstruction: Surgical Techniques and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on postmastectomy breast reconstruction including implant-based and autologous (DIEP flap) techniques, complications such as capsular contracture and skin necrosis, nipple reconstruction, and comparative outcomes across reconstruction methods.
subtopics.short_description: Implant-based and autologous reconstruction techniques, complications, and comparative outcomes after mastectomy.

subtopics.label: Radiotherapy and Immunotherapy in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on radiation therapy approaches for breast cancer including hypofractionation, prone positioning, MRI-guided radiotherapy, and the combination of radiation with immunotherapy (checkpoint inhibitors, TLR agonists, CD40 agonism). Includes studies on radiation-induced neoantigens and immune modulation.
subtopics.short_description: Hypofractionation, MRI-guided radiotherapy, and radiation combined with checkpoint inhibitors and immune modulators.

subtopics.label: Breast Imaging, Diagnosis, and Biopsy
subtopics.description: Studies on breast imaging modalities including MRI (DCE-MRI, abbreviated MRI), ultrasound, contrast-enhanced mammography, and tomosynthesis for lesion detection, characterization, and biopsy guidance. Includes quantitative imaging methods, AI-assisted image analysis, and management of imaging findings.
subtopics.short_description: MRI, ultrasound, contrast-enhanced mammography, and AI-assisted image analysis for lesion detection and biopsy.

subtopics.label: Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Research examining disparities in breast cancer incidence, treatment access, reconstruction rates, psychosocial care, and outcomes across racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic groups. Includes studies on African American, Hispanic, and Asian American populations and interventions to reduce disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in incidence, treatment access, reconstruction rates, and outcomes across racial and socioeconomic groups.

subtopics.label: Hereditary Breast Cancer Genetics and Cascade Testing
subtopics.description: Research on hereditary breast cancer risk genes (BRCA1/2 and others), cascade genetic testing strategies, polygenic risk scores, variant classification, and the molecular consequences of BRCA deficiency including DNA repair mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: BRCA1/2 and other hereditary risk genes, cascade testing strategies, polygenic scores, and DNA repair mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Breast Tumor Molecular Biology and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Studies on the molecular biology of breast cancer including gene expression, non-coding RNAs, transcription factors, signaling pathways (PI3K, STIM1/NFAT1), tumor heterogeneity, and tissue biomarkers such as stem cell markers (CD44, CD24, ALDH1A1) and IHC-based assays.
subtopics.short_description: Gene expression, signaling pathways, tumor heterogeneity, and IHC-based tissue biomarkers including stem cell markers.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Metastasis and Tumor Metabolism
subtopics.description: Research on mechanisms of breast cancer metastasis including organ tropism, metabolic reprogramming (copper, propionate, glucose metabolism), and novel therapeutic strategies targeting metastatic progression in TNBC and other subtypes.
subtopics.short_description: Organ tropism, metabolic reprogramming, and therapeutic strategies targeting metastatic progression in TNBC and other subtypes.

subtopics.label: Ductal Carcinoma In Situ and Early-Stage Breast Cancer Management
subtopics.description: Studies on the diagnosis, treatment decision-making, quality of life, and patient-reported outcomes in ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) and early-stage breast cancer, including cryoablation, active surveillance criteria, and local therapy choices.
subtopics.short_description: Treatment decision-making, active surveillance, cryoablation, and patient-reported outcomes in DCIS and early-stage disease.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Risk Factors, Epidemiology, and Tissue Composition
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies on breast cancer risk factors including reproductive factors, diet (carotenoids, vitamin D), anthropometric measures, alcohol, environmental exposures (radon, PM2.5), and their associations with breast tissue composition and cancer incidence.
subtopics.short_description: Reproductive factors, diet, environmental exposures, and their associations with breast tissue composition and cancer incidence.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Survivorship, Quality of Life, and Comorbidity Management
subtopics.description: Research on survivorship issues in breast cancer including quality of life after treatment, management of comorbidities (diabetes, cardiovascular disease), weight management, psychosocial well-being, and patient-reported outcomes during and after treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Post-treatment quality of life, comorbidity management, psychosocial well-being, and patient-reported outcomes in survivors.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Vaccine Effects and Pandemic Impact on Breast Imaging
subtopics.description: Research examining COVID-19 vaccine-induced axillary adenopathy and its imaging implications, as well as the pandemic's disruption of breast imaging volumes and operational recovery across North America.
subtopics.display_name: COVID-19 Vaccine Effects on Breast Imaging
subtopics.short_description: Vaccine-induced axillary adenopathy and pandemic-related disruptions to breast imaging volumes and program recovery.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genome Structural Variation and Multi-Omics Characterization
subtopics.description: Studies applying genome-scale sequencing and multi-omics approaches to characterize complex structural variants, chromatin conformation, and tumor heterogeneity across cancer types including breast cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Genome-scale sequencing and multi-omics characterization of structural variants, chromatin conformation, and tumor heterogeneity.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning and Computational Methods in Precision Oncology
subtopics.description: Development and application of machine learning models—including biologically constrained and deep learning frameworks—to improve cancer risk prediction, treatment response, and molecular profiling.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning and biologically constrained models for cancer risk prediction, treatment response, and molecular profiling.

subtopics.label: CDK Inhibitors and Cell Cycle Regulation in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Mechanistic and translational studies of CDK4/6 inhibitors and their effects on cell cycle regulators such as p21 and CDK2, informing therapeutic strategies in breast cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanistic and translational studies of CDK4/6 inhibitors and cell cycle regulators informing therapeutic strategies.

subtopics.label: Exercise, Immune Microenvironment, and Reproductive Factors in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Research investigating how physical activity and reproductive factors modulate the breast tumor immune microenvironment and influence cancer progression in preclinical and clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Physical activity and reproductive factors as modulators of the breast tumor immune microenvironment and cancer progression.

subtopics.label: Cardiotoxicity and Cardio-Oncology in Breast Cancer Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies assessing cardiac toxicity from breast cancer therapies—including radiotherapy and chemotherapy—using imaging modalities such as PET and MRI to monitor subacute and chronic cardiovascular effects.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiac toxicity from radiotherapy and chemotherapy assessed via PET and MRI imaging for cardiovascular monitoring.

subtopics.label: Cancer Screening Access, Policy, and Health System Interventions
subtopics.description: Population-level studies examining adherence to cancer screening guidelines across diverse patient groups—including stroke survivors, mental illness patients, and Medicaid enrollees—and the policy interventions that affect screening uptake.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level screening adherence across diverse patient groups and policy interventions affecting screening uptake.

subtopics.label: Patient-Derived Models and Novel Biomarkers for Cancer Detection
subtopics.description: Development of patient-derived in vitro and in vivo cancer models and novel blood-based or imaging biomarkers—including methylation assays and circulating macrophage-like cells—for cancer detection and monitoring.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived cancer models and blood-based or imaging biomarkers including methylation assays for detection and monitoring.

subtopics.label: Global Health, Capacity Building, and Decision Support in Oncology
subtopics.description: Research addressing global breast oncology capacity-building in low-resource settings, decision-making support for racial and ethnic minorities, and health literacy as a determinant of cancer outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Capacity-building in low-resource settings, decision support for minority populations, and health literacy in cancer outcomes.

subtopics.label: Advanced PET Imaging and HER2/ER Biomarker Assessment in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies utilizing advanced PET imaging modalities such as FES-PET for estrogen receptor-positive brain metastases and evaluating HER2 protein expression levels including very low HER2 subsets.
subtopics.short_description: FES-PET for ER-positive brain metastases and evaluation of HER2 expression levels including very low HER2 subsets.

subtopics.label: Adolescent and Young Adult Cancer: Fertility Preservation and Trial Participation
subtopics.description: Research focused on adolescent and young adult cancer patients, including fertility preservation service utilization, clinical trial accrual patterns, and SOGI data collection to address underrepresentation.
subtopics.short_description: Fertility preservation, clinical trial accrual, and SOGI data collection in adolescent and young adult cancer patients.

subtopics.label: Hereditary Cancer Risk Communication and Family Notification
subtopics.description: Studies examining the communication of hereditary cancer risk information to at-risk relatives, including barriers to family notification and the role of diverse ancestry consortia in understanding hereditary cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Barriers to communicating hereditary cancer risk to at-risk relatives and the role of diverse ancestry consortia.
